slug: 2026-01-19 South Sudan introduces digital payment system for passports after supply crisis

systems.system: digital payment system for passports and national ID
systems.country_label: digital system (bank-linked payment for immigration documents)
systems.owner: National Revenue Authority, with the immigration directorate; said to be supported by European Union services
systems.tiers: immigration compound in Juba, through a commercial bank on site; from 19 January 2026

systems.country_label: biometric registration exercise for public servants

note: About payment for passports and national identity cards. Civil registration appears only as something analysts say immigration systems should be integrated with; the piece states there is no unified national digital ID interoperable with the civil registry.
